title: The House With No Name
subtitle: 数学逻辑 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 数学逻辑（科学与技术·数学与逻辑）
meta: 主题语境：数学逻辑（科学与技术·数学与逻辑）　|　核心词汇：number　|　正文 369 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 number 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: Our house had no name and, for eleven years, no ① number, which made it very hard to be delivered to and fairly easy to hide in. My father, a mathematician who had stopped publishing, said the ② number of a house is the first thing a state asks for and the last thing a person needs. He was not joking, and he was not right either.

The post office solved it by ③ numbering the lane from the church, which gave us eleven and gave the farm thirty-one, and which everybody ignored. Every number, he said, belongs to somebody. What people actually used was a description: 'the house with the green door, past the bend'. A ④ number of us, meaning me and two cousins, spent a summer checking how many letters arrived addressed that way, and the answer was all of them.

My father's own difficulty was different. He had ⑤ numbers in his head that he could not write down — long sequences, primes mostly — and he said they were company, which I found alarming at ten and understand at forty. A ⑥ number, he explained, is not a quantity; it is a thing with properties, like an animal. He was a bad teacher and a good one, and I have never been able to separate the two.

In 1994 the council finally ⑦ numbered the lane properly, and the ⑧ number of complaints was eleven, all of them from people whose houses had moved. The letters that went astray ⑨ numbered in the hundreds. There was no number on the new signs that anybody could read in the dark, and the postman, who had been doing the job for twenty-six years, went on using descriptions and was right to.

He died in 2001. The house is number eleven now, and I say it when I am asked, and I have never once used it to find the place myself. What he gave me, I now think, was not arithmetic. It was the sense, which I found in a ⑩ number of an old journal of his, that counting is a claim about the world: that something can be counted, that it stays counted, and that somebody has to be willing to do the counting.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 数字；数目（表示数量的数）
B. n. 号码；编号（门牌、电话等）
C. n. 数量；总数（the number of）
D. v. 编号；给……标号码（number sth）
F. 固定搭配：a number of 若干；一些
G. n. 数（数学对象，常用复数 numbers）
H. n. （杂志的）一期；（刊物的）一册

items.q: the number of a house is the first thing a state asks for
The post office solved it by numbering the lane
A number of us, meaning me and two cousins
He had numbers in his head
A number, he explained, is not a quantity
the council finally numbered the lane
the number of complaints was eleven
The letters that went astray numbered in the hundreds
a number of an old journal of his

answers.why: 指门牌“号码”，说我们家十一年没有门牌号。
同样指房号、编号，说房号是国家最先要的东西。
number 作动词，意为“给……编号”，说邮局从教堂开始给这条巷子编号。
a number of 意为“若干、一些”，指我和两个表亲几个人。
numbers 指数学上的“数”，说他脑子里有一串写不下来的数，多半是素数。
number 指“数字、数目”，他说一个数不是量，而是有性质的东西。
动词，意为“编号”，说议会终于正式给巷子编了号。
the number of 意为“……的数量”，说投诉的数量是十一起。
number 作动词，意为“共计、达到……之数”，说投错地方的信数以百计。
a number of a journal 意为“一期期刊”，说我在他一本旧期刊的某一期里读到这个意思。
